subject: Request: 'Twilight' APAC facilitator window for co-sell demo (AWS + SI)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@ordosystems.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.singh@aws-partner.amazon.com, demo-coordinator@auroragrid.com
Date: 2028-04-24T22:05:00Z
Subject: Requesting a 'twilight' APAC facilitator window for our co-sell demo

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the joint demo next week. Our SI team at Ordo is seeing a conflict where our lead solutions architect will be only available 19:30–21:30 SGT on Fri (too late for a standard APAC slot). AWS (Priya copied) suggested a short "twilight" window that bridges EMEA/APAC and lets the SI run the deep technical module while still keeping Redwood as the initial host.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a facilitator and tech backup for a 60-minute hybrid window starting 19:45 SGT (10:45 UTC) on Friday 4/28? If not exact, alternate proposal attached (proposed-timeslot-grid.csv) with a couple of neighboring twilight options.

Constraints:
- Must include an AWS specialist on the call (Priya has offered limited availability).
- Keep the first 15 minutes for customer context, 35 minutes for live demo, 10 minutes for Q&A.

We attached a quick runbook and suggested facilitator responsibilities. If you can't staff it, can we move to 9:00 SGT on Monday and still keep AWS engaged?

Appreciate a quick confirm — Ordo is on a tight go-live plan.

Thanks,
Alex
Partner Programs | Ordo Systems
mobile: +44 7700 900111

Attachment: twilight-window-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook stub)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@ordosystems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priya.singh@aws-partner.amazon.com, demo-coordinator@auroragrid.com
Date: 2028-04-25T01:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Requesting a 'twilight' APAC facilitator window for our co-sell demo

Alex —

Appreciate the context and the runbook. Quick read: this is doable but requires an ops handover and an on-call override to keep our tail-latency SLOs happy. Vanessa, Karthik — can either of you take facilitator for a 19:45 SGT start on 4/28?

If we staff it, I want to do the following before we lock:
- 30m prep rehearsal with Ordo + AWS (preferably 4/28 at 17:00 SGT)
- Confirm AMI/instance sizes and that Ordo's model weights are pre-loaded to the staging cluster (Ops ticket OPS-1428)
- Short rollback plan (30s fallback: switch to recorded demo + chat Q&A)

Alex — if Priya can confirm AWS coverage, I'll commit a facilitator. If not, we should target Mon 4/31 09:00 SGT (but I'm guessing that'll force an EMEA change).

Markus
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
--

I can facilitate the window on 4/28 at 19:45 SGT. Two quick notes:
1) Ops need the load profile 48h ahead — Alex, can Ordo confirm expected concurrent users and whether the demo will kick off a 30-second synthetic load?
2) I prefer the rehearsal to be tomorrow 17:00 SGT (4/27 09:00 UTC). If that doesn't work for Priya or Alex, we can do a 30-minute dry run Thursday 15:00 SGT.

I've attached a minimal facilitator checklist to the runbook (added as twilight-window-runbook-v1.pdf). Karthik — can you own the rollback toggle and ensure a trimmed quantized model is available as fallback?

Thanks all — quick confirmations from AWS side:
- I can join the live window at 19:45 SGT on 4/28 and will bring a solutions architect to support the infra callouts.
- Ordo: please confirm the synthetic load profile by EOD 4/27 so we can pre-warm the instance pool.
- Markus / Vanessa: we've added OPS-1428 to the AWS-engagement board and granted temporary elevated metrics access for the rehearsal.

If Ordo sends the load numbers and the rehearsal goes well, I'm OK with the twilight window as-is. If something slips, let's flip to the recorded fall-back and run a live Q&A — we can still call it a success for the prospect motion.

See you on the rehearsal — Priya
Partner Solutions Manager | AWS Partner Network
